svg.text: Faceless Shorts at scale: Class 6–12 Maths & Science
One topic catalog → reviewed scripts → reusable visual kits → GPU render farm (on demand) → 3 languages → YouTube
Columns: class · subject · chapter · concept · template · style · languages · status · video link · views
a template per way of explaining
Script: Hinglish / Hindi / English lines + caption chunks
VISUAL KITS: build once, reuse in every video
a new video = script + a few settings, not 500 lines of code
add workers when the queue grows: Kaggle T4 today, any cloud GPU tomorrow
approved script + kit settings + language, in batches
WARN: shot length, caption timing, unheard words
contact sheet of the whole video
A failed check sends the video back to the farm queue; a passed one moves to publishing.
YouTube Shorts, organised like the syllabus
Estimates: ~270 chapters across NCERT Maths 6–12 and Science 6–10 + Physics, Chemistry, Biology 11–12; 4–5 concept Shorts per chapter; 3 languages.
Throughput grows with GPU workers (roughly 3–4 videos per GPU-hour for 3D, more for 2D). Facts from NCERT; never its text or figures.
